name: independent-autobot-worker-contract-v1
purpose: Fan-out six production specialist lanes into independent GitHub runners while preserving isolated edit, verification, recovery, handoff and operator-controlled integration contracts.

productionLane.changePolicy: No specialist candidate is automatically merged; central fan-in records every result and protected integration remains operator-controlled.

fanOut.dispatcher: planner/coordination layer chooses bot, objective, baseRef and coordinationId
fanOut.isolation: Each specialist gets its own workflow run, isolated worktree, candidate branch, Aider execution and failure boundary.

fanIn.rule: Every dispatched worker must produce exactly one ledger record; failed workers remain visible and are never silently dropped.
fanIn.codeMerge: Candidate branches remain separate until a verified integration controller explicitly merges them against the recorded base SHA.

resourceIsolation.aider: one Aider process per worker workflow
resourceIsolation.model: Each production specialist owns its own local model process; sibling workers never share an Aider/Ollama workspace.
resourceIsolation.failureBoundary: A failure in one specialist job must not cancel or contaminate sibling specialist jobs.
